scope.geography: San Jose/greater Bay Area first; Cleveland/Ohio second; nationwide expansion used because priority areas alone did not yield enough strong verified roles
scope.selection_rule: Exact role must be currently visible on the employer's official careers site or official ATS. PhD timing is not used as a hard exclusion; scientific fit and actual job existence are prioritized.

jobs.posting_status: Verified current on Xaira's official Greenhouse ATS
jobs.job_description: Lead organoid model development for high-throughput CRISPR functional-genomics screens, working with computational biology and AI/ML teams.
key_must_have_requirements: PhD in relevant biology field with 0–4 years post-graduate experience
jobs.why_good_match: The strongest verified Bay Area role: organoids, single-cell genomics, R/Python and model reproducibility align closely with the user's background, while adding functional genomics.

jobs.title: Scientist 3 — Translational Medicine
jobs.posting_status: Verified current on Genentech official careers site; posted October 6, 2026
jobs.job_description: Bridge wet-lab translational biology and high-dimensional data analysis to discover/validate biomarkers and therapeutic mechanisms.
key_must_have_requirements: PhD in biological sciences with 0–4 years relevant post-graduate experience or equivalent track record
Cell culture, ELISA, qPCR and NGS/transcriptomics
R or Python for high-dimensional data
